Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: Compile Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "homer11" ]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      go_version:
        description: Go version override (empty = use src/go.mod)
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  compile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install build requirements
        run: |
          sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y openssl ca-certificates libluajit-5.1-dev

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          # Empty go-version falls back to go-version-file, so PR checks always
          # match the toolchain required by src/go.mod (manual dispatch can override).
          go-version: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.go_version || '' }}
          go-version-file: src/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: src/go.sum

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Compile project
        run: |
          make release

  postgres-regressions:
    name: PostgreSQL ${{ matrix.postgres }} regressions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - postgres: '17.11'
            image: postgres:17.11@sha256:3b0cda93be7c8dba2ed484d19393d93845dc3dafb88973e248ba8e6d99d784e1
          - postgres: '18.6'
            image: postgres:18.6@sha256:3a4264520e121176619f54ff867d12774bc81e95e7b84db58d63bccdb6144b81
    services:
      postgres:
        image: ${{ matrix.image }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: homer_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: homer_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d homer_test"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    env:
      CGO_ENABLED: 1
      GOMAXPROCS: '2'
      GOFLAGS: -p=2
      HOMER_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN: postgres://postgres:homer_test@127.0.0.1:5432/homer_test?sslmode=disable
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install test requirements
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential ca-certificates libluajit-5.1-dev curl

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.go_version || '' }}
          go-version-file: src/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: src/go.sum

      - name: Install checksum-verified DuckDB extensions
        run: |
          ./scripts/download_duckdb_extensions.sh
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.duckdb/extensions"
          cp -R bundled_extensions/v1.5.6 "$HOME/.duckdb/extensions/"

      - name: Run PostgreSQL regressions
        working-directory: src
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          go test -race ./config ./cli ./storage/ducklake ./coordinator/services ./node ./server ./writer \
            -run 'Test(Postgres|NodeReadsPostgres|DiscoverSchemaViews|LoadPostgresDuckLakeCatalog|NormalizePostgresDSN|IsPostgresSettingsPath|JWTSecretFilePathWithPostgresSettings|AttachSQLBuildersReturnErrors|CatalogErrorKeepsDiagnosticsWithoutCredentials|SQLiteShardSpillDirectoryUnchanged|LocalSecretDefaultsAndOverride)' \
            -count=1 -json -timeout=10m | tee postgr

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
